---
name: Trial feedback
about: Tell me how the skill did on a real job
title: "Trial: "
labels: feedback
---

Please don't paste confidential or personal customer data. Remove client names.

**What did you ask the skill to do?**
(The mode and a short version of your prompt. Example: "Review a landing page for a B2B SaaS, traffic from LinkedIn ads.")

**What facts did you give it?**
(Customer quotes? Proof? Competitor pages? Nothing?)

**What worked?**

**What sounded like fluff, generic or wrong?**
(Quote the line if you can.)

**Did it invent anything?**
(A number, a customer, a source, a mechanism. Say what.)

**Was the diagnosis right?**
(Audience, awareness stage, sophistication stage. What did it get wrong?)

**Did you test the copy? If so, what happened?**
(Control, variant, sample, metric, result. "Haven't tested" is fine.)

**Your role and market**
(For example: freelance copywriter, in-house marketer; country; B2B or B2C. Optional.)

**Which version of the repo?**
(The commit hash or the date you cloned it.)
